## Outcome

Describe the user or agent workflow this changes. Link the issue when relevant.

## Verification

List exact checks, their results and the disposable environment used. Distinguish
real-backend/game evidence from fixture tests. Link sanitized screenshots or
diagnostics for visible changes; retain the first failure if one occurred.

## Compatibility and limits

State affected CLI/HTTP/MCP contracts, restart or migration requirements and
anything not tested. Documentation-only changes can mark this not applicable.

- [ ] Related tests and documentation match the implementation.
- [ ] No credentials, session tokens, private paths or generated runtime state are included.
- [ ] Capability and platform claims are supported by the stated evidence.
